The mean payment replenishment latency following an initial threshold alert is currently 6.42 hours, decreasing sharply to 1.10 hours under critical (< $5.00) balance conditions. Revenue leakage risk remains constrained within regulatory tolerances, with less than 1.8% of low-balance events cascading into automated service suspension.**

---

| **Critical Alert Replenishment Latency** | 1.10 hrs | 2.00 hrs | -45.00% | Normal |
| **SMS Delivery Success Rate (Carrier Ack)** | 99.1% | 98.5% | +0.61% | Normal |
| **Post-Alert Remote Disconnect Cascade Rate** | 1.78% | 2.50% | -28.80% | Normal |
